input_metadata.mass_formulation: B31 default LUMPED=YES; ROTARY INERTIA=EXACT; explicit conflicting options rejected
input_metadata.coordinate_basis: Abaqus global right-handed X,Y,Z; Y vertical for this input
input_metadata.component_labels: From input element-set membership, not hard-coded element numbers

convention.inertia: J=integral((r dot r)I-r*r^T)dm; off-diagonal entries are negative products
convention.state: Undeformed input geometry and fixed rotor orientation; no gyro/operating aeroelastic reduction

existing_DAT.scope: Existing M2 DAT; center-of-mass tensor, not RP tensor. No solver invoked.

limitations: Beam-carrier properties do not establish physical flexible/rotating RNA validity.
Continuous rod properties are a separate representation, not automatically the B31 solver inertia.
Tensor components remain in Abaqus global coordinates; no unverified OpenFAST axis map is applied.
Only five physical component rows partition the RNA. Rotor/blades/zone/total rows overlap.
Solver or original input is never modified; unsupported formulations raise errors.
